description: File converter. Use when a task has a file in one format and needs it in another: a Word document (.docx) to HTML, Markdown or plain text; HTML to Markdown or plain text; Markdown to HTML; CSV to JSON; JSON to CSV; or CSV and TSV either way. Send the file as a URL or base64, or paste the text. Input is capped at 6 MB, or 1 MB when the target is Markdown, and nothing is stored. Cost: 1 credit per call.

file_base64.description: The document as base64. Exactly one of text, url or file_base64.

from.description: The input format: docx, html, markdown, csv, json or tsv.

text.description: The document as text. Not accepted for docx, which is binary.

to.description: The output format. Supported pairs are returned on every response and on an unsupported_conversion error.

url.description: A public http(s) URL to read the document from.

name: file_convert
